modelDescription: The Elevation MTR 2.0 (Mountain Tactical Rifle) is a premium, lightweight tactical rifle available at an affordable price. It features our Sendero contour carbon fiber barrel, lightweight carbon fiber stock, Zermatt Arms Origin action, detachable box magazine, and a TriggerTech trigger, all backed by our SUB MOA accuracy guarantee.
